arxiv-2111-08746.title: Adaptive Transmit Waveform Design Thanks: This research was funded by the Office of Naval Research and NUWC’s internal investment program.
arxiv-2111-08746.creator: David A. Hague
arxiv-2111-08746.description: Abstract Recent research efforts in the Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW) community have focused on developing sonar systems that adapt to their acoustic environment, referred to as “cognitive” sonars. Cognitive active sonar systems utilize principles of the perception action cycle of cognition to leverage information gathered from earlier sensing interactions with the underwater acoustic environment [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2201-06403.title: The corner element of generalized numerical semigroups Thanks: 2020 Math. Subj. Class. : Primary 20M14; Secondary 05A15, 05A19 Thanks: Keywords : generalized numerical semigroup, genus, corner
arxiv-2201-06403.creator: Matheus Bernardini, Wanderson Tenório, Guilherme Tizziotti
arxiv-2201-06403.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Matheus Bernardini, Wanderson Tenório, Guilherme Tizziotti. In this paper we introduce the concept of corner element of a generalized numerical semigroup, which extends in a sense the idea of conductor of a numerical semigroup to generalized numerical semigroups in higher dimensions. We present properties of this new notion and its relations with existing invariants in the literature, and provide an algorithm to compute all the generalized numerical semigroups with fixed corner.

arxiv-2202-00172.title: Fractional Motion Estimation for Point Cloud Compression
arxiv-2202-00172.creator: Haoran Hong ⋆, Eduardo Pavez ⋆, Antonio Ortega ⋆, Ryosuke Watanabe †, Keisuke Nonaka † ⋆ University of Southern California, Los Angeles CA. 90089 USA † KDDI Research, Inc, Japan ⋆ {haoranho,pavezcar,aortega}@usc.edu † {ru-watanabe,ki-nonaka}@kddi-research.jp
arxiv-2202-00172.description: Abstract Motivated by the success of fractional pixel motion in video coding, we explore the design of motion estimation with fractional-voxel resolution for compression of color attributes of dynamic 3D point clouds. While the approach has been demonstrated in several research papers, the software tools used to build such a simulator remain unavailable or proprietary.

arxiv-2503-20019.title: Exploiting ν \nu -dependence of projected energy correlators in HICs
arxiv-2503-20019.creator: Ankita Budhraja, Balbeer Singh
arxiv-2503-20019.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ankita Budhraja, Balbeer Singh. We extend the recently derived factorization formula for energy-energy correlators to study the analytic structure of general ν 
u -point projected energy correlators in heavy ion collisions. The ν 
u -point projected energy correlators (or, ν 
u -correlators) are an analytically continued family of the integer N N -point projected energy correlators, which probe correlations between N N final-state particles.

arxiv-2505-08873.title: Threshold Dynamics and Integrated Control of Cholera Transmission with Sanitation and Vaccination
arxiv-2505-08873.creator: Abdallah Alsammani, Gassan A.M.O. Farah, Mohammed A.Y. Mohammed, Mehmet Yavuz
arxiv-2505-08873.description: Abstract Cholera transmission is sustained by interacting human and environmental pathways, making integrated control essential in settings with inadequate water, sanitation, and hygiene infrastructure. We develop and analyze a Susceptible–Infected–Recovered–Water (SIWR) model with Monod-type environmental transmission and three interventions: human sanitation, environmental sanitation, and vaccination.

arxiv-2507-16313.title: Hyperbolicity and Schwarz Lemmas in Calibrated Geometry
arxiv-2507-16313.creator: Kyle Broder, Anton Iliashenko, Jesse Madnick
arxiv-2507-16313.description: Abstract This paper has two main objectives. First, for an arbitrary calibrated manifold ( X , ϕ ) (X,\phi) , we define notions of R ϕ R_{\phi} -hyperbolicity and ϕ \phi -hyperbolicity, which respectively generalize the notions of Kobayashi and Brody hyperbolicity from complex geometry.

pmc-10672715.title: Cardiovascular Disease in Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease
pmc-10672715.creator: Sowmya Swamy, Sahibzadi Mahrukh Noor, Roy O Mathew, Radica Alicic, Christos Argyropoulos
pmc-10672715.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a common occurrence in patients with diabetes mellitus (DM), occurring in approximately 40% of cases. DM is also an important risk factor for cardiovascular disease (CVD), but CKD is an important mediator of this risk.

pmc-10863755.title: Electrophysiological Characteristics and Ablation Outcomes in Patients With Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia
pmc-10863755.creator: Lishui Shen, Shangyu Liu, Feng Hu, Zhenhao Zhang, Jiakun Li, Zihao Lai, Lihui Zheng, Yan Yao
pmc-10863755.description: BackgroundCatheter ablation of premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) that trigger polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (PVT) or ventricular fibrillation has been reported as a novel therapy to reduce the syncope events in patients with catecholaminergic PVT, whereas the long‐term ablation outcome and its value in improving exercise‐induced ventricular arrhythmias remain unclear.

pmc-11291735.title: Prognostic and therapeutic value of the Eph/Ephrin signaling pathway in pancreatic cancer explored based on bioinformatics
pmc-11291735.creator: Jifeng Liu, Qihang Yuan, Xu Chen, Yao Yang, Tong Xie, Yunshu Zhang, Bing Qi, Shuang Li, Dong Shang
pmc-11291735.description: Pancreatic cancer (PC) is one of the most common malignant tumors of the digestive tract and has a very high mortality rate worldwide. Different PC patients may respond differently to therapy and develop therapeutic resistance due to the complexity and variety of the tumor microenvironment. The Eph/ephrin signaling pathway is extensively involved in tumor-related biological functions.

pmc-11301838.title: Adaptation and validation of the evidence-based practice profile (EBP2) questionnaire in a Norwegian primary healthcare setting
pmc-11301838.creator: Nils Gunnar Landsverk, Nina Rydland Olsen, Kristine Berg Titlestad, Are Hugo Pripp, Therese Brovold
pmc-11301838.description: BackgroundAccess to valid and reliable instruments is essential in the field of implementation science, where the measurement of factors associated with healthcare professionals’ uptake of EBP is central. The Norwegian version of the Evidence-based practice profile questionnaire (EBP2-N) measures EBP constructs, such as EBP knowledge, confidence, attitudes, and behavior.

pmc-11738746.title: From Irritability to Amnesia: Unraveling Thalamic Glioma – a Case Report
pmc-11738746.creator: Oyku Inanc, Tirth Dave
pmc-11738746.description: AimsGliomas, encompassing astrocytomas, oligodendrogliomas, and ependymomas, constitute the majority (40–55%) of primary brain tumors. Diagnosis can be challenging due to their uncommon nature, subtle symptoms, and diverse clinical manifestations. While neurological signs are typical, psychiatric symptoms may occasionally precede them.

pmc-12290739.title: Valenced tactile information is evoked by neutral visual cues following emotional learning
pmc-12290739.creator: Mana R. Ehlers, James H. Kryklywy, Andre O. Beukers, Sarah R. Moore, Brandon J. Forys, Adam K. Anderson, Rebecca M. Todd
pmc-12290739.description: Learning which stimuli in our environment co-occur with painful or pleasurable events is critical for survival. Previous research has established the basic neural and behavioral mechanisms of aversive and appetitive conditioning; however, it is unclear precisely what information content is learned.

pmc-12452968.title: Identification of Core SASP-Related Genes TGFBI and ANXA6 for Diagnosing Ulcerative Colitis-Related Colorectal Cancer Through Machine Learning
pmc-12452968.creator: Jukun Zhang, Ping Wang, Siqi Yuan, Yingjian Zhang
pmc-12452968.description: PurposeTo explore the role of senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) in ulcerative colitis-related colorectal cancer (UCRCC) precision diagnosis and pathogenesis.MethodsIn this study, we first screened the SASP-related genes (SASPRGs) in the ulcerative colitis (UC) and colorectal cancer (CRC) datasets using differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA).

pmc-12504586.title: Artificial Intelligence in Electrocardiography: From Automated Arrhythmia Detection to Predicting Hidden Cardiovascular Disease
pmc-12504586.creator: Ramy Elantary, Samar Othman
pmc-12504586.description: Cardiovascular diseases are among the most prevalent and deadly diseases affecting humans. The most widely used diagnostic tool to interrogate cardiovascular physiology and function is an electrocardiogram (ECG). Despite its widespread availability and use, the ECG is subject to interobserver variability and suboptimal sensitivity for asymptomatic or early-stage disease.

pmc-12561495.title: Effects of Suppression and Expression of Academic Emotions on Peer Acceptance in Outperformance and Underperformance Situations
pmc-12561495.creator: Ying Liu, Biao Sang, Phillip Ozimek
pmc-12561495.description: The current study was conducted to investigate the cross-situational differences in the effect of the suppression and expression of academic emotions on peer acceptance in situations involving outperformance and underperformance. A total of 81 adolescents were randomly selected to evaluate a target classmate’s acceptance level when underperforming or outperforming in a predetermined hypothetical setting using two questionnaires.

pmc-12598482.title: Application of multivariate techniques for estimating herd feed efficiency using chemical and near-infrared calibration models in dairy cattle
pmc-12598482.creator: Valentina Novara, Mattia Masseroni, Maddalena Canossa, Antonio Gallo
pmc-12598482.description: Graphical AbstractSummary: Near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy is widely used in animal nutrition to evaluate the chemical composition of diets and feeds. In addition, its application is now also extensive and well proven for the evaluation of some indirect parameters, such as the digestibility of diets or animal efficiency.

pmc-12855873.title: Effects of Bacillus pumilus precipitation on the flexural strength of jute fibre reinforced concrete
pmc-12855873.creator: Uwemedimo Nyong Wilson, Abraham Salami, Mohammed Abdulkareem Adisa
pmc-12855873.description: This study investigates the influence of Bacillus pumilus–induced calcium carbonate precipitation (MICP) on the flexural performance and durability of jute fibre–reinforced concrete (JFRC). A nominal 1:2:4 concrete mix with 1% jute fibre (treated and untreated) was prepared and dosed with three bacterial concentrations (B1.5, B12, and B24).

pmc-12930303.title: Insights on Survival and Recurrence After Surgery in Malignant Meningiomas: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12930303.creator: Renindra Ananda Aman, Ria Amelia, Hafiz Arqursoy, Hermawan Pramudya, Ismail Fajri
pmc-12930303.description: Background: Malignant meningiomas (WHO Grade III) are rare, aggressive tumors with poor prognosis and high recurrence rates. Gross total resection (GTR) is the preferred treatment; however, recurrence remains a challenge, especially after subtotal resection (STR). The role of adjuvant radiotherapy (RT) and chemotherapy in improving patient outcomes remains controversial.

pmc-13386491.title: Effects of TNF-α, IL-1β and IL-2 on regulatory T cells in children with idiopathic nephrotic syndrome
pmc-13386491.creator: Fen-Fen Ni, Shi-Lei Jia, Cheng-Rong Li, Xiao-Jie Gao
pmc-13386491.description: PurposeThe pathogenesis of idiopathic nephrotic syndrome (INS) is unknown, but previous studies suggested that alterations of immune cells and cytokines have a role. We investigated the effects of multiple cytokines on the level of regulatory T cells (Tregs) in children with INS.MethodsBlood samples were collected from children with INS before and after glucocorticoid therapy and from age-matched healthy controls.

pmc-13400702.title: Can Field-Based Screening Predict ACL Injury Risk in Women Footballers? External Validation of a Prediction Model

pmc-13470176.title: Contained rupture of a thoracic aortic aneurysm at the diaphragmatic hiatus: A case report
pmc-13470176.creator: Kyler Shin, Lauren Pupa, Molly Lieux Furrow, Milan Maheshwari, Craig Kym, Mukul Maheshwari
pmc-13470176.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Contained rupture is a rare complication of aortic aneurysms and occurs less frequently in the thoracic aorta compared to the abdominal aorta. Rapid enlargement of a contained rupture is a high risk factor for free rupture. Radiography and cross-sectional imaging play a vital role in the prompt diagnosis of contained rupture, which is significant given its treatment may differ from that of other aortic complications.
